summary: session + query deep dives: ExpandableQuery + queries CSV
description:
Session deep dive (/admin/sessions/[id]) + query deep dive (/admin/queries/[id]) per BRD §1.8, §1.9, design §4.4, §4.5.  Includes CSV export for a session's queries (BRD §1.18).

Files:
  - src/app/(admin)/admin/sessions/[id]/page.tsx  (new)
  - src/app/(admin)/admin/queries/[id]/page.tsx  (new)
  - src/app/api/admin/sessions/[id]/route.ts  (new)
  - src/app/api/admin/queries/[id]/route.ts  (new)
  - src/app/api/admin/sessions/[id]/queries.csv/route.ts  (new)
  - src/components/admin/ExpandableQuery.tsx  (new — design §3.7, native <details>/<summary>)
  - src/__tests__/admin-sessions.test.ts, admin-queries.test.ts

Done when:
  - Session deep dive: breadcrumb (links to user + sessions), stat tiles, list of <ExpandableQuery> collapsed by default, Expand-all/Collapse-all anchor links.
  - Query deep dive: same payload as a single expanded <ExpandableQuery>, raw-JSON <details> open by default.
  - Expanded view shows the model_pricing row used (input/output/cached rate, effective_from) per BRD §1.8.  This is the diagnostic surface for 'why did this query cost more.'
  - Ctrl-F searches inside collapsed <ExpandableQuery> content (verifies the native <details> choice).

Tests:
  - Endpoint contract for both routes (404 to non-admins).
  - Component test: collapsed contains truncated query (Ctrl-F works); expanded contains full prompt + response.
  - CSV streams.

resolution.note: Session deep dive: header + stat tiles + ExpandableQuery list + CSV link + expand-all/collapse-all via ?expand=all. Query deep dive: standalone with details + raw JSON open by default. Per-query model_pricing LATERAL join shows the rate row effective at query time. ExpandableQuery uses native <details> so Ctrl-F finds collapsed content. 9 new tests; full suite + tsc + build clean.
